purpose: Skadi icon concepts for review; not installed
prompts: Create one square raster desktop app icon CONCEPT for Skadi, a marine-themed terminal. No text, no letters. Richly crafted natural-history illustration with tactile gouache and fine engraving-like stippling, strong silhouette readable as an icon, not a vector logo, not flat minimalism, not generic glossy AI app art. Deep navy, cold turquoise, ivory foam, realistic organic asymmetry. Subject occupies most of the square with breathing room, dark ocean background, no device mockup. Reference observations from real humpback photos: broad flukes with a pronounced central notch and irregular scalloped trailing edges, fine scars and mottling; head has rounded tubercles, dark skin, white ventral throat pleats; ocean foam is irregular lace over layered swells. Concept A: a humpback's raised tail seen from behind just before a deep dive. Wide flukes span the upper two thirds, clearly visible white and charcoal mottled underside unique to an individual, weathered skin and small scars, scalloped trailing edge, water pouring in fine threads from both flukes. Narrow muscular tail stock descending into a compact ring of turbulent turquoise water. Painterly scientific wildlife plate, dramatic but restrained side lighting. Anatomically credible tail, no symmetrical butterfly logo.
